'''Ítróttarfelag Fuglafjarðar''', abbreviated to '''ÍF''', is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]]  [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Fuglafjørður]]. They play their home games at [[Í Fløtugerði]]. The [[1979 1. deild|1979]] [[Faroe Islands Premier League]] title is ÍF's sole to date. They also won the [[1. deild]] (second tier) four times."}}
